name: [PARIS] Explore the World ✈️
desc:
✈️ Check in, board your flight and fly to London or Paris! Explore the World is an airport roleplay where you're a passenger and the journey is the adventure.

🧳 Pick your destination and roll your carry-on through security
☕ Grab a snack, try a massage chair or play the arcade before boarding
🛫 Find a seat, watch the safety demo and take off
🍽️ Order a meal, play in-flight games and follow the live flight map
🛬 Land and ride the bus into the city
🎡 Ride the London Eye and hear Big Ben chime
🗼 Take the lifts to the top of the Eiffel Tower
📸 Snap photos for postcards, fill your passport with stamps and earn badges

💺 Fly Economy, upgrade to First Class for the lounge and a lie-flat suite, or book a private jet for you and four friends.

👥 Invite friends to your party and fly together.

👍 Like and ⭐ favourite if you enjoyed the trip!

llm.loop: check in at airport -> go through security and board -> fly with in-flight activities -> land and explore London/Paris landmarks -> collect passport stamps
llm.objectives: travel, explore cities and fill your passport
llm.progression: passport stamps, badges, miles, cabin class upgrades
llm.instructions: check in, board, fly, land and explore London or Paris
unique: full airport-to-city travel journey with real landmarks
llm.thumbnails: landmarks (Big Ben, Eiffel Tower) with EXPLORE THE WORLD title and destination text
llm.complexity_notes: multiple detailed maps (airport, plane, two cities) with scripted travel
